about: The one error catalog (#2449; owner 2026-10-21 「还有，错误那一块，是不是应该有一种统一的方式？我不想错误都散落在各处」). Adding an error = adding an entry here, then `node scripts/sync-error-catalog.mjs`. README.md has the rules.

errors.agent: 品牌与资料 failed while doing {operation}{on_target} (a fault in the platform, not in your call)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Continue another way, and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 品牌资料出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: 品牌与资料 could not be reached for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds. If it fails again, continue another way and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 品牌资料暂时连不上，稍后再试。

errors.agent: The conversation's cloud environment is being archived after a long idle, so {operation}{on_target} waits until it is stored (usually under a minute, a few minutes at most)
errors.next: Run the command again in a minute: the environment then starts again from its archive with its files as they were.
errors.user: 云端沙箱正在归档，稍后会继续。

errors.agent: The conversation's cloud environment is being attached or started again, so {operation}{on_target} waits
errors.next: Run the command again in a moment.
errors.user: 云端沙箱正在启动，稍后会继续。

errors.agent: {operation}{on_target} named something that cannot hold a cloud sandbox: only a cloud environment (env_…) does; a conversation's commands run in its environment, a space's program and tasks in an environment of the run that started them (a fault in the platform, not in your call)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Continue another way, and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 云端环境出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: The conversation's cloud environment could not be started for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Run the command again shortly; if it keeps failing, run it on the person's computer (env_enter) or tell the person the cloud environment is unavailable.
errors.user: 云端沙箱暂时启动不了。

errors.agent: The conversation's cloud environment is there, but its host program (hostd) did not answer {operation} within its start-up wait
errors.next: Run the command again in a minute; if it keeps failing, run it on the person's computer (env_enter) or tell the person the cloud environment is unavailable.
errors.user: 云端沙箱还没准备好，稍后再试。

errors.agent: Connections are not open for this account yet ({operation})
errors.next: Continue without a connection; do not retry. Tell the person in one plain sentence that connecting outside services is not open for them yet.
errors.user: 连接功能还没有对你开放。

errors.agent: {operation}{on_target}: the connection file would not be valid, so nothing was registered; the cause names every problem by file and field
errors.next: Fix each named field in the connection file, save it as a new version of its space, then check or publish that version again.
errors.user: 连接文件有错误，没有发布。

errors.agent: {operation}: there is no connection file at {target}
errors.next: Check the path and the version: the ref is <space>/<path>@<version> and the path names the .yaml file itself (connections/<name>.yaml). List the space's files at that version if unsure.
errors.user: 找不到这个连接文件。

errors.agent: {operation}: connection id {target} is already published from another file
errors.next: Unpublish the connection that holds this id first, or give this file another id; one id is one file at a time, so it is always clear which file runs.
errors.user: 这个连接名已经被另一个连接文件占用。

errors.agent: {operation}{on_target}: the request is not valid; the cause says which part
errors.next: Fix the named part and call again: a connection ref is <space>/<path>@<version> (wrk_…/connections/<name>.yaml@<version>), a connection id is a slug such as orders.
errors.user: 请求内容不对，请检查后重试。

errors.agent: {operation}: connection {target} is not published
errors.next: List the person's connections to see which are published, or publish this one first.
errors.user: 这个连接还没有发布。

errors.agent: {operation}: connection {target} has no earlier published version to go back to
errors.next: Name the version to pin instead (publish that ref), or leave the current one.
errors.user: 这个连接没有更早的发布版本。

errors.agent: {operation}{on_target}: no signing secret of this connection waits to be shown; the cause says why (shown once already, not looked at within 24 hours, or shown at the person's own publish)
errors.next: Do not retry: a signing secret is shown once. To give the sender a new one, name a new secret in the connection file's signing credential (secret:<new name>) and publish the file again; the new secret is shown once.
errors.user: 这个签名密钥已经看过或过期了，不能再显示。

errors.agent: {operation}: a connection file cannot be read from {target} yet
errors.next: Keep connection files in a 作品 the person owns (wrk_…), e.g. connections/<name>.yaml; other spaces follow when the Space Server serves them.
errors.user: 这个空间里的连接文件暂时还不能使用。

errors.agent: The connector failed while doing {operation}{on_target} (a fault in the platform, not in your call)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Continue another way, and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 连接器出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: The connector could not be reached for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds. If it fails again, continue another way and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.

errors.agent: Control failed on {operation} with an error no handler names (a platform bug)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Report the request id; continue another way.
errors.user: 出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: Task dispatch could not be reached for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds. If it fails again, continue another way and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.

errors.agent: The credential {target} that {operation} needs is missing, revoked or needs a new login
errors.next: Do not ask for the value in chat. Tell the person in one plain sentence which credential to add or reconnect in 连接 / 设置 → 密钥, then continue once they have.

errors.agent: Custom tools failed while doing {operation}{on_target} (a fault in the platform, not in your call)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Continue another way, and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 自定义工具出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: Custom tools could not be reached for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds. If it fails again, continue another way and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 自定义工具暂时连不上，稍后再试。

errors.agent: Control's database could not be reached for {operation}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds.
errors.user: 服务正忙，稍后再试。

errors.agent: The AgentRouter app on the person's computer (hostd) refused the arguments of {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: The cause names the argument and what it must be; fix that and call once more.
errors.user: 参数不对，这一步没有执行。

errors.agent: The AgentRouter app on the person's computer (hostd) could not set the write boundary for {operation}{on_target}, so the command did not run
errors.next: Do not retry unchanged. Tell the person in one plain sentence that the computer could not protect that folder (it may be on a USB stick or network drive, or owned by another account); a folder on an NTFS disk they own works.
errors.user: 电脑没能保护这个文件夹，命令没有运行。

errors.agent: Folder mode on the person's computer cannot confine local tools for {operation}{on_target}: its confinement needs a one-time change only that computer's administrator can make (on Ubuntu, an AppArmor rule that lets AgentRouter's own confinement program make user namespaces: `sudo agentrouter computer userns install`; elsewhere, a kernel setting); `agentrouter computer setup` cannot make it
errors.next: Do not retry. Tell the person, in one plain sentence, the exact command the cause gives and what it is for (it asks for the computer's login password); after they ran it, call once more. Until then nothing runs in that folder.
errors.user: 这台电脑要管理员确认一次设置，按提示运行那一行命令后再试。

errors.agent: The AgentRouter app on the person's computer (hostd) failed while doing {operation}{on_target} (a fault on that computer, not in your call)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done; updating or restarting AgentRouter on that computer may fix it.
errors.user: 电脑上的 AgentRouter 出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: The AgentRouter app on the person's computer (hostd) could not be reached for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Check list_devices: if that computer is offline, tell the person and do not resend now; otherwise try once more in a few seconds.
errors.user: 电脑暂时连不上，稍后再试。

errors.agent: The cloud environment that runs commands (hostd) cannot mount the session's space as an on-demand checkout for {operation}{on_target}: its hostd has no checkout (an outdated sandbox image) or the platform has no node daemon configured. A cloud environment has no other way to see the space (#2767)
errors.next: The command did not run and retrying will not help. Tell the person in one sentence that the cloud environment needs an update and stop running commands in this turn; the platform team gets this from the log.
errors.user: 云端环境需要更新，命令没有执行。

errors.agent: The space checkout on the computer that runs commands (hostd) could not read the space version it was asked to show for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds with a fresh checkout ticket; if it fails again, continue without the space's files and say which ones could not be read.
errors.user: 空间文件暂时读不到，稍后再试。

errors.agent: The answer to {operation}{on_target} was not a Control error envelope: something between the session runner and Control (the edge in front of the agent gateway, or the gateway) answered instead, and its status and what it said are in the cause
errors.next: Retry once in a few seconds if retry can help. If it answers the same way, the platform's path to Control is failing: tell the person in one sentence that the cloud environment could not be reached, and do not run more commands in this turn.
errors.user: 云端环境连不上，命令没有执行。

errors.agent: The agent gateway could not get an answer for {operation}{on_target}; the cause says why
errors.next: Retry once in a few seconds; if it fails again the platform is restarting or down: tell the person in one sentence and stop for this turn.
errors.user: 云端服务正在重启，稍后再试。

errors.agent: The space checkout on the computer that runs commands (hostd) could not reach the space content service for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds; if it keeps failing, the content service of that region is down.
errors.user: 空间文件暂时读不到，稍后再试。

errors.agent: The space checkout on the computer that runs commands (hostd) got an answer it could not use from the space content service for {operation}{on_target} (a fault in the platform)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Continue without that file and tell the person in one plain sentence which file could not be read.
errors.user: 这个文件读取出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: The space checkout on the computer that runs commands (hostd) received file content for {operation}{on_target} whose checksum is not the one the space version names, so it did not show it
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Continue without that file and tell the person in one plain sentence which file could not be read.
errors.user: 这个文件校验没有通过，没有打开。

errors.agent: The space checkout on the computer that runs commands (hostd) could not store a fetched file in its local cache for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Free disk space in this environment (delete files you made and no longer need), then try again.
errors.user: 空间不足，文件没有打开。

errors.agent: The space checkout on the computer that runs commands (hostd) could not mount the space at {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Nothing to do: the platform falls back to a full copy of the space here.
errors.user: 这台电脑先用完整拷贝。

errors.agent: No space checkout is mounted for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Mount the space first, then ask for its changes.
errors.user: 空间还没有打开。

errors.agent: The space checkout on the computer that runs commands (hostd) could not list the changes made in the space for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Try once more; if it fails again, unmount and mount the space again (the changes stay on this computer).
errors.user: 改动暂时没能收集，稍后再试。

errors.agent: The space checkout on the computer that runs commands (hostd) could not read a folder of the space version while listing changes for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds with a fresh checkout ticket.
errors.user: 改动暂时没能收集，稍后再试。

errors.agent: The space checkout on the computer that runs commands (hostd) could not read a changed file while listing changes for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Check that the file is readable (it may have been made unreadable by a command), then ask for the changes again.
errors.user: 有个改过的文件读不到，改动没能收集。

errors.agent: The person's computer is linked, but the AgentRouter app there (hostd) is still starting the server that does {operation}{on_target} (in folder mode it starts confined, which can take half a minute or more); nothing ran
errors.next: Call it once more in about 10 seconds. It is not an old AgentRouter: do not ask the person to update.
errors.user: 电脑上的工具还在启动，稍后会继续。

errors.agent: The person's computer is offline, so {operation}{on_target} did not run there (it is not linked right now, it dropped and did not come back within the reconnect wait, or the link gateway could not reach it)
errors.next: The same call works once that computer is online again (remote_hosts / list_devices shows it): ask the person to start `agentrouter link` on it (the terminal must stay open), then call again; meanwhile keep working where you are (or env_leave to your default environment). Jobs already started there keep running. Do not resend in a loop.
errors.user: 电脑没有连上：在那台电脑上重新运行 agentrouter link。

errors.agent: This Agent's definition sets resource limits for its environment (environment_memory_mb / environment_processes / environment_cpu_percent), and the person's computer did not take them for {operation}{on_target}, so nothing runs there unlimited
errors.next: Do not retry. Tell the person their computer could not apply the limits (the cause says which value or which local tool), or keep working in your default environment in the cloud (env_leave).
errors.user: 这台电脑没能设上这个 Agent 要求的资源上限，所以没有在上面运行。

errors.agent: This Agent's definition sets resource limits for its environment, and the agentrouter on the person's computer ({operation}{on_target}) predates them, so nothing runs there unlimited
errors.next: Do not retry. Ask the person to update agentrouter on that computer (then link again), or keep working in your default environment in the cloud (env_leave).
errors.user: 这台电脑上的 agentrouter 太旧，设不了这个 Agent 要求的资源上限。请先更新。

errors.agent: The link to the host dropped while {operation}{on_target} was running, so it may or may not have taken effect there (a read-only call is already sent again once)
errors.next: Check the state there first (read the file or list the folder again), then redo only what did not happen.
errors.user: 连接中断了，这一步可能没有完成。

errors.agent: A background job's output could no longer be read from its environment (every read failed for the retry window, or one was refused for good), so the job is no longer followed and its end is unknown
errors.next: Check what the command left behind (its files, its own status command) before starting it again; tell the person in one sentence that the job's progress was lost.
errors.user: 后台任务和运行环境失去联系，结果未知。

errors.agent: Memory failed while doing {operation}{on_target} (a fault in the platform, not in your call)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Continue another way, and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 记忆出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: Memory could not be reached for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds. If it fails again, continue another way and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 记忆暂时连不上，稍后再试。

errors.agent: {target} is not in this Agent's reach, so {operation} did not run: neither its definition (with its slots as the install maps them) nor a grant gives it (the cause lists what it reaches and how to add it)
errors.next: Work with the spaces and computers this Agent reaches. If it needs this one, ask the person in the conversation (a sub-Agent: say so in its result) — name it and what for: the person grants it for this conversation or permanently (their grant route, POST /api/control/personal/agents/grants); the Agent that dispatched you can grant a part of its own reach. No Agent grants on the person's behalf. Calling again before a grant will not work.
errors.user: 这个 Agent 的定义里没有包含它，这一步没有执行。

errors.agent: The platform tool failed while doing {operation}{on_target} (a fault in the platform, not in your call)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Continue another way, and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 这一步出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: The platform tool could not be reached for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds. If it fails again, continue another way and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 这一步没连上，稍后再试。

errors.agent: Platform tool {operation}{on_target} gave no answer before the kernel's tool-call limit, so Control stopped it and answered now instead of letting the kernel time out: the work was cancelled at its source (a computer's command, a device job, an upstream request), and whatever it already changed stays changed
errors.next: Check whether the step already took effect (read the file, list the job, look at the space) before calling it again. For long work use the tool's running form (env_exec answers running with a job id; read it with job, stop it with stop) or split it into smaller steps. If the cause names a slow or lost link, try once more in a minute.
errors.user: 这一步太久没回应，已经停下。

errors.agent: The kernel's MCP client gave up waiting for platform tool {operation}{on_target} (its own words are the cause, e.g. "Request timed out"): Control's answer did not arrive in time. The kernel sent a cancel, which stops the call at its source when it reaches Control; until then the work may still have been running
errors.next: Check whether the step already took effect before calling it again. If it keeps happening, the path between the conversation's sandbox and Control is slow: continue with smaller steps and tell the person in one plain sentence.
errors.user: 这一步没等到回应。

errors.agent: {operation}: a space's simulate section is invalid{on_target}
errors.next: Fix the space's .ar/space.yaml simulate section or the file it names (space_op describe lists the problem), then start the run again.
errors.user: 这个空间的模拟设置有问题。

errors.agent: {operation}: no simulation run{on_target} of this person
errors.next: Use a run id agent_try returned (sim_…).
errors.user: 找不到这次模拟。

errors.agent: {operation}{on_target}: the simulation run has ended; its own copy of the spaces it held was dropped with it, so nothing more is written
errors.next: Start a new simulation run (agent_try with simulate) to try again; read what this one did with agent_try { report: [run] }.
errors.user: 这次模拟已经结束了。

errors.agent: {operation}: an event of the scenario{on_target} cannot be played
errors.next: Each event is { at, message } (what the person says), { at, space, insert, rows } (rows arriving in a table) or { at, space, emit, payload } (a declared event), with at in ms or as 40s / 2m / 1h (at most 24h), on a space the run holds.
errors.user: 这个模拟场景里有一条事件写得不对。

errors.agent: {operation}: the scenario set{on_target} cannot be read
errors.next: A scenario set is a YAML file: schema agentrouter.scenarios/v1 and scenarios: a list of { id, title?, why?, message?, events?, grants?, speed? } (AGENT-RUNTIME §8.2). Start a run with scenario: { id, file: "wrk_…/path.yaml" } or scenario: { id, set: <the file's text> }.
errors.user: 这个模拟场景文件写得不对。

errors.agent: {operation}: the scenario names a space by the template it was copied from{on_target}, and there is no such copy
errors.next: Copy the template first (space_copy <template>), or name the space by its id (wrk_…).
errors.user: 这个模拟要用的空间还没有加进来。

errors.agent: {operation}: a run the person starts plays the Agent as she is (her recipe's spaces and her permanent grants), and the scenario's grants name a space she does not hold{on_target}; with no Agent dispatching the run there is nobody to grant it for this run only
errors.next: Grant the space to this Agent for good (agent_grant scope permanent) or name it in her recipe, then start again; or start the scenario from a conversation with agent_try, whose Agent grants it from her own reach.
errors.user: 这个 Agent 还没有这个空间，先把空间给她再模拟。

errors.agent: {operation}: this conversation is a simulation run; its changes stay in the run's drafts{on_target}
errors.next: Go on with the task; the person keeps or drops the run's drafts after it.
errors.user: 模拟中的改动不会提交。

errors.agent: {operation}: simulation runs are not available in this process{on_target}
errors.next: Try without simulate, or again once the Space Server is reachable.
errors.user: 模拟暂时不可用。

errors.agent: {operation} would act on the person's linked computer{on_target}, and a simulation run never acts outside itself
errors.next: In a simulation run, work in the cloud environment (your own commands and files there, remote_copy to cloud:); reading a computer's files stays allowed. Do this for real in a normal conversation.
errors.user: 模拟里不会动你的电脑。

errors.agent: {operation} was refused{on_target}: what it was given cannot be written
errors.next: The cause names what cannot be written; fix the call and send it again.
errors.user: 这次写入的内容不对，没有保存。

errors.agent: {target} is not in the view this turn of the session pinned, so {operation} could not write it
errors.next: The runner mints this conversation's view again by itself when a space joins it (one you made, one the person granted) and syncs once more; this error comes back only when the space is still not in your reach. Check space_list: if it is not listed, ask the person to grant it; if it is, call space_open with its id once and run the command again.
errors.user: 这个空间刚建好，还没进入这一轮的工作区，重试一次就好。

errors.agent: {operation}: the space's runtime instance is not running{on_target}
errors.next: Its program runs on the person's computer: check that computer is linked and online (env_list), then call the op again.
errors.user: 这个空间的程序还没在运行。

errors.agent: {operation}: the space's runtime program answered with an error{on_target}
errors.next: Read the cause; fix the arguments if they are wrong, or call again once the program is healthy (its run view shows its state).
errors.user: 这个空间的程序出错了。

errors.agent: {target} is not a tool of this conversation ({operation}); the cause says why
errors.next: Use a tool from your tool list for this step; calling the same name again will not work in this conversation.
errors.user: 这个工具在这次对话里用不了。

errors.agent: {target} was removed from the platform's tools after this conversation's tool list was made ({operation}); the cause says when
errors.next: Do what the call was for with the replacement named here, with the arguments it describes; do not call the removed tool again.
errors.user: 这个工具已经换成新的了。

errors.agent: {operation} is missing arguments the tool requires{on_target}; the cause names them, the arguments it does not take, and its current input schema
errors.next: Call it again with every argument the cause lists as required (the tool may have gained one since your tool list was made); leave out the arguments it does not take.
errors.user: 这一步的参数不完整。

errors.agent: The person's computer has too many open preview connections to answer {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Wait a few seconds, then open it once more; close previews you no longer need.
errors.user: 电脑上同时打开的预览连接太多，稍等几秒再刷新。

errors.agent: Nothing listens on that port of the person's computer for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Check that the dev server runs on that computer and listens on 127.0.0.1 (its log, or a command there); start it again if it stopped.
errors.user: 网页没有响应。它可能正在启动，或者刚刚停下了：稍等几秒再刷新，还不行就回到对话，让 AI 看看。

errors.next: Do not retry. Start the dev server with a command in this environment (then its port opens), or use the port of the server you started; the person's own programs are previewed only when they link with 完全访问.

errors.next: Retrying will not help. Continue another way, and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 项目服务出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: The Space Server refused {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: The cause names what was refused; fix that before trying again.
